A small update: from now on, Windows copies update themselves with one click.

## Updates

- **Update now works wherever you keep the app.** Press **Update now** and STL Editor downloads the new version, checks it, puts it in place of the one you have and starts again. It keeps the same name and the same place, so your shortcuts go on working, and unsaved work is offered by Recover Unsaved Work. It works from the Downloads folder, the desktop, a USB stick or anywhere else Windows lets the app write.
- Before, a copy downloaded from the website only offered a **Download** button, and you had to swap the file yourself.

## Getting it

- **If you have 2.0 on Windows:** this one update still comes as a **Download** button. Download **STL-Editor-2-Windows.exe**, close STL Editor, and use the new file in place of the old one. After that, new versions arrive through **Update now**.
- **Mac and Linux:** use the **Download** button, as before.
- **New here?** Windows: download **STL-Editor-2-Windows.exe**, put it anywhere and double-click it. It isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info › Run anyway**.
- **Mac (beta):** download **STL-Editor-2-macOS.app.zip** and unzip it. The first time, right-click it and choose **Open**.
- **Linux (beta):** download **STL-Editor-2-x86_64.AppImage**, make it executable and run it.
- **In your browser:** https://natterman12.github.io/STL-Editor/app/

Everything that was new in 2.0 is in the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/natterman12/STL-Editor/releases/tag/v2.0.0).
